description: This Python source file defines the LangFuseHandler class, which manages retrieval and caching of LangFuseLogger instances based on request parameters and dynamic credentials. It handles dynamic configuration, caching, and provides methods to obtain loggers for specific requests or globally.

classes.name: LangFuseHandler
classes.description: A class providing static methods to manage LangFuseLogger instances based on request parameters and dynamic credentials.

methods.name: get_langfuse_logger_for_request
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a LangFuseLogger for a specific request, using dynamic credentials if provided, or falling back to a global logger.

methods.name: _return_global_langfuse_logger
methods.description: Returns the global LangFuseLogger, or creates and caches one if not already available.

methods.name: _create_langfuse_logger_from_credentials
methods.description: Creates a LangFuseLogger from provided credentials and caches it.

methods.name: get_dynamic_langfuse_logging_config
methods.description: Generates a LangfuseLoggingConfig object based on request parameters and global logger.

methods.name: _dynamic_langfuse_credentials_are_passed
methods.description: Checks if dynamic credentials are provided in the request parameters.
